convention.scope: Actual CPU-dispatched graph plus explicit Python scalar formulas; input/checkpoint/seed-specific logical arithmetic, not universal FLOPs.
convention.basic: add/sub/mul/div/negate/reciprocal each one; convolution dense full-kernel MAC=2 including zero padding; bias add separate
convention.special: sqrt, exp, general power, tanh each one logical special primitive, reported separately
convention.batchnorm: Canonical two-pass variance, sqrt then reciprocal; affine separate; training running-statistics updates included. Backward reuses centered=x-mean, honors requested gradient masks. Local backend kernels may use another algorithm.
convention.variance: Mean then centered squares then sum/divide:4N basic; correction denominator shape arithmetic excluded
convention.norm_p2: N squares plus N-R reduction adds plus R sqrt; actual composed autograd backward counted by dispatched operations
convention.unitnorm_host: Every actually executed native UnitNorm invocation evaluates max_power*np.sqrt(latent_elements_per_image):1 basic multiply +1 special sqrt, beyond the dispatched tensor norms. Counted by native module hook.
convention.bilinear: align_corners=False only; nested value blends9/output, gradient four contributions each two multiplies and scatter-add12/output; axis weights precomputed canonically5*(OH+OW)+2 basic per operator, including two scale divisions. Coordinate clamps comparisons counted. Index casts/floors/control excluded as coordinate indexing; no special floor primitive claimed.
convention.tanh: one special primitive forward; g*(1-y*y):3 basic backward
convention.relu: one comparison per output; selection zero arithmetic
convention.random: normal draws counted; RNG internal algorithm excluded
convention.zero: allocation/copy/views/indexing(selection or replacement, not accumulation)/integer shape and control arithmetic excluded; floating rate metadata arithmetic disclosed as metadata_basic but excluded from signal logical FLOPs
